2. Open Tickwell on the watch and tap Use Tickwell face. You can also touch and hold your watch face and pick it from the list.
3. To change the style or hand colour, touch and hold the face, then tap Customize.

The watch app can play a soft tick-tock every second while the screen is on, in step with the seconds hand. It works with any watch face and stays silent in Do Not Disturb. Turn it on in the app on your watch, or add the Tick sound Tile.
